name: Zhejiang Zhengte Co., Ltd.
summary: Originating in Linhai, China, in 1996, Zhejiang Zhengte Co., Ltd. is a firm dedicated to the creation, production, and distribution of sun protection solutions and alfresco furniture for markets both domestically and worldwide. The company's diverse portfolio encompasses items such as parasols, pergolas, marquees, and pavilions, alongside products crafted from recycled plastics, building materials, and various other furnishings. Furthermore, it extends original equipment manufacturing (OEM) services to clients.
